name: dsp-openapi-comparison
description: This project compares two ways of generating Node.js server stubs from the same OpenAPI specification.

scripts.generate:server: openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi/openapi.yaml -g nodejs-express-server -t out -o generated-openapi-generator-custom
scripts.generate:final: npm run generate:response-metadata && npm run generate:server
scripts.start:initial: cd generated-openapi-generator && npm install && npm start
scripts.test: npm run test:response-metadata && npm run test:lab01 && npm run smoke
scripts.test:lab03: node scripts/lab03-protocol-tests.js && node scripts/lab03-client-robustness-tests.js && node scripts/lab03-server-concurrency-tests.js && node scripts/lab03-large-file-and-matrix-tests.js && node scripts/lab03-alpha-conversion-tests.js && node scripts/lab03-interoperability-tests.js
scripts.test:lab04: node scripts/lab04-schema-tests.js && node scripts/lab04-service-tests.js && node scripts/lab04-realtime-tests.js
scripts.test:lab04:client: cd shared-services/lab04/client-app && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:lab05: node scripts/lab05-schema-tests.js && node scripts/lab05-topic-tests.js && node scripts/lab05-service-tests.js && node scripts/lab05-mqtt-gateway-tests.js && node scripts/lab05-hygiene-tests.js && node scripts/lab05-integration-tests.js && node scripts/lab05-regeneration-tests.js
